SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_buyer_value
FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_semantic_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
